Name: Wendigo Monster Replacement
Author: ChaseXavier
Description:
How to install
**Place the Skeleton.xnb and the WildernessGolem.xnb
into

StardewValley > Content > Characters > Monsters

**How to use**

Spawn the Wendigo?

In the Smapi CMD command box, type in

monster_spawn Skeleton
or
monster_spawn wildernessGolem

ENJOY !!

**Make sure you check for the mods required for this to work ! **
